## 1.1 部署

```bash
curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh
```

## 1.2 运行

```bash
ollama run deepseek-r1:7b
```

## 1.3 查看现有模型

```bash
ollama ls
```

## 1.4 singin

```bash
ollama singin
```

## 1.5 卸载

```bash
ollama rm deepseek-r1:7b
```
